# Spectro Cart SC-7

The Spectro Cart SC-7 is a portable spectrometer on a wheeled cart, for
reading soil and plant samples in the field. It is made by
[[pemberton-scanning]] and stored at [[kelmouth-site]].

## Calibration

The spectrometer is calibrated once a month with a white reference tile.
